$Comment: A bauble in the branches: while Christmas runs, chopping down a tree trunk sometimes shakes loose one
of the game's Winter Baubles, landing on the broken block like anything the trunk drops. The trees
are the game's own, found all year; only this find is seasonal. The file name is the row's id.
When names BreakBlock, a block a player breaks that they did not place, so trunks a player sets down
and chops again never pay. Match *_Trunk covers every tree's trunk block (Wood_Oak_Trunk,
Wood_Fir_Trunk and the rest) and the giant fern and mushroom stems that share the ending; a trunk's
half, full and stair blocks end otherwise and stay out. Chance is the row's own odds as a percent (5
is about one trunk in twenty). Season leaves the whole row out while Christmas is off, so its roll
needs no condition of its own. The roll carries the find's sound (its Cue). A server owner retunes or
switches off this row by its id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/bonus-rows.json.
